data.name: Basira
data.gender_notes: Basira is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Basira means 'intelligent' or 'wise' in Arabic. It is derived from the root 'b-s-r' which is related to insight and vision. The name Basira carries the meaning “Intelligent, Wise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Basira usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, the term 'basira' refers to inner sight or spiritual insight (Quran 48:18, 48:20).
data.etymology: Basira belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intelligent, Wise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Basira total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: باسرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: باسرة هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل 'بصر' الذي يعني الإبصار والفطنة والحكمة. يرمز الاسم إلى الشخصية التي تتمتع بالبصيرة العميقة والقدرة على التمييز بين الأمور، وهي من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني روحانية وصفات حميدة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: باسرہ
in_urdu.meaning: بصیرت، حکمت، اور فطرت کے معنی والا نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: باسرہ ایک علم کا نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب بصیرت، حکمت، اور فطرت سے ہے۔ یہ نام ان خصائل کو ظاہر کرتا ہے جو ایک فرد میں بصیرت کی گہرائی اور مختلف امور کے درمیان تمیز کرنے کی صلاحیت ہوتی ہے۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام روحانی معانی اور محمودہ صفات کے حامل ناموں میں سے ایک ہے۔

in_hindi.name: बासिरा
in_hindi.meaning: बासिरा नाम का अर्थ है - बुद्धिमत्ता, अन्तर्दृष्टि
in_hindi.long_meaning: बासिरा एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है, जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है बुद्धिमत्ता, अन्तर्दृष्टि और समझदारी। यह नाम उन गुणों को दर्शाता है जो एक व्यक्ति में गहरी समझ और विभिन्न मामलों के बीच अंतर करने की क्षमता होती है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम आध्यात्मिक महत्व और अच्छे गुणों के साथ जुड़ा हुआ है।

in_pashto.name: باسره
in_pashto.meaning: باسره د بصيرت او حکمت معنا
in_pashto.long_meaning: باسره يو ښځينه نوم دى چه د پښتو ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دى. دى نوم د بصيرت، حکمت، او فطرت څخه عبارت دى. دا نوم هغه ځانګړتیاوې څرګندوي چې په يوه فرد کې د بصيرت ژوروالى او د مختلفو چارو تر منځ د توپير کولو وړتيا لرى. په پښتني کلتور کې، دا نوم روحاني معنا او ښې ځانګړتیاوې لري.

in_english.name: Basira
in_english.long_meaning: Basira is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the root 'b-s-r' which means 'to see' or 'to perceive'. The name signifies insight, wisdom, and good judgment. In Islamic tradition, Basira is associated with spiritual awareness and the ability to discern between right and wrong. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting its significance in Islamic values and personality traits such as intuition, understanding, and sagacity.

The Prophet Muhammad himself is reported to have said that seeking knowledge is an obligation for every Muslim. The name Basira would be highly esteemed in a Muslim society as it connotes intelligence, insight, and sharpness.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Basira embodies the concept of inner wisdom and insight that comes from a deep connection with Allah. The Quran regularly emphasizes the importance of having a sound intellect and having the ability to understand the truth. Basira, therefore, represents a gift from Allah that allows individuals to discern and understand the divine guidance and wisdom contained within the Quran and the teachings of the prophets. It underscores the significance of seeking knowledge, wisdom, and understanding from the divine source, rather than relying solely on worldly knowledge.
